in_marathi.name: Ishvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ishani's power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishvika is derived from the name Ishani, meaning goddess of power. Ishvika is a name for a girl imbued with the divine power of the goddess Ishani.
